d: Alexander Volkanovski successfully defended his featherweight title with a dominant TKO victory over Movsar Evloev at UFC 333. Evloev started strongly, but Volkanovski turned the contest around with a decisive right hand in the second round. The champion followed up with a powerful series of strikes to secure the finish at 4:54 of Round 2. With this victory, Volkanovski handed Evloev the first defeat of his professional MMA career.
